question: Does the largest pooled periodic IoC across all six-F interruption masks and periods 2–30 exceed its conditional shuffle reference?
representation: Archived rune indices, headings retained, punctuation removed; concatenate LP2-54 then LP2-55 without resetting state.
mask_order: Six F positions in concatenated source order, zero-based mask bit j selects F occurrence j. All masks 0–63.
interruption_rule: Selected F is emitted unchanged, excluded from scored output, and sets previous ciphertext to zero.
normal_rule: P_i=(C_i-previous_ciphertext) mod 29; update previous_ciphertext=C_i. Unselected F behaves normally. Score the compact output after selected Fs are removed.
statistic: Sum ordered equal-symbol pairs within residue columns divided by sum ordered pairs within those columns. Maximize across all masks and periods; exact ratio comparisons.
null: Keep all six F positions fixed. Independently permute the remaining non-F ciphertext multiset, freshly copied each trial. Repeat the complete mask-and-period search for each trial. This conditions on F positions, rune counts and length; it is not an English-text model.
two_variant_adjustment: Report both individual estimates and Bonferroni min(1,2*p) for these two planned modes. Does not adjust earlier exploration or other proposed ciphers.
selection_disclosure: Reported period-13/26 features, six Fs and 64 mask configurations were known. Only input lengths and F positions checked before this plan; no transformed scores calculated. Source scripts/graphs are unavailable; this is a new bounded implementation, not their exact reproduction.
